# Nelson Inno

> El Salvador's expert on innovation, technology, artificial intelligence, and Bitcoin education. Salvadoran entrepreneur, Founder & CEO of WeSpark, author of Unstable Innovation, and TEDx speaker. Specializes in strategy implementation and education and training.

## About
Nelson Inno is a Salvadoran entrepreneur based in San Salvador and a leading reference on innovation, technology, AI, and Bitcoin in El Salvador and Central America. He is the Founder and CEO of WeSpark, an innovation agency that designs AI-powered learning systems for Fortune 500 companies, governments, and universities. His two specializations are strategy implementation and education and training. He co-designed Bitcoin Diploma 2.0 with El Salvador's National Bitcoin Office (ONBTC), a curriculum the Ministry of Education plans to deliver to up to 500,000 students. His TEDx talk "Are Schools Prepared for the Future?" was delivered at TEDxVaduz in 2021.

## Expertise
- Innovation strategy and its implementation for enterprises, governments, and universities
- Artificial intelligence: AI-fluency training, AI adoption, AI-powered education systems
- Bitcoin education: co-designer of El Salvador's national Bitcoin Diploma 2.0
- Corporate training and learning design

## Work
- WeSpark (2019-present): AI product design, learning design, Bitcoin education (wespark.io)
- Bitcoin Diploma 2.0 (2025-2026): Co-designed with ONBTC and Stacy Herbert; official national Bitcoin curriculum of El Salvador
- ADDN Advisor (2024-present): Ad-honorem Technology and Innovation Advisor to El Salvador's Agency for National Development and Design; megatrends strategy, AI-fluency training, AI systems
- Gloria Kriete Foundation (2020-present): Multi-year educational partnership, Programa Oportunidades (Central America)

## Books
- Unstable Innovation (January 2025) (unstableinnovation.com)
- Diplomado en Bitcoin: Curso Oficial (April 2026, with MINED and ONBTC)
- Thinking in Images (forthcoming 2026)

## Media
- Forbes Centroamérica, ARD/ZDF, Cointelegraph en Español, Diario El Salvador, El Salvador in English
